purpose: Publish the controlled bilingual 2018–2019 Registry notice, ob rem and non-convalidation reconstruction and register it as an eight-node family in the Concurso 36/2012 control room.
mandatory_boundaries: The 26-Jun-2018 Auto was operative within its express partial scope; later judicially characterised error does not by itself establish voidness or crime.
The 24-Oct-2019 Auto refused convalidation and is corrective counterevidence, not proof that every title, money, possession and Registry consequence was reversed.
Burofax delivery on 4-Jan-2019 proves institutional receipt, not automatic personal reading by every officer.
The Registrar gave a reasoned adverse response and the Registry identified an ob rem obstacle; silence/collaboration must not be claimed.
The Cuatrecasas Registry intervention is affirmative protective conduct and defeats a total-abandonment formulation.
No common criminal plan, procedural fraud, punishable insolvency offence or judicial prevaricación is established.
